From the Rulings (and FAQ)
Also, there are two rulings which concern aggravated damage during combat:

a.. - Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage
(So the +1 damage from Lucky Blow is aggravated for Basilia).
b.. - The base damage does not inherit the properties of the additional
damage (So a Saturday Night Special with Dragon's Breath Rounds does 1
normal plus 2 aggravated damage).
So if I have Mass Reality in play at Superior, and I use the Ivory Bow to
strike, do I inflict 3 Agg?

seems clear cut, just wanted to confirm.

David
